baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ربكم, ادعوني, and أستجب لكم sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The nurturing sovereign initiates speech, the addressee turns speech toward Him, and He completes the exchange with a returning answer.

activation_trace.role: Overt utterance makes the promise an initiated speech act rather than an abstract proposition.
Nurture, repair, and completion define the speaker's mode of lordship.
Directed vocal address supplies the caller's turn in the exchange.
A returned answer supplies reciprocal completion of the call.

changed_reading.before: A command to pray followed by a promise that a request will be granted.
changed_reading.after: The Lord opens a direct two-party speech circuit in which calling is already met by committed return.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root ج و ب in أستجب.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside verbal reply, the response root carries penetration, opened space, and disclosure, allowing an answer to be an aperture through an obstruction.

activation_trace.role: Penetrating separation contributes the image of an answer cutting through blockage.
An opened interval turns response into newly available room or passage.
Disclosure contributes an answer that reveals what was obscured.

changed_reading.before: أستجب means only a verbal yes or fulfilled request.
changed_reading.after: The promised answer may also arrive as breakthrough, opened access, or clarification.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reversal from يستكبرون عن عبادتي to سيدخلون جهنم داخرين.
baseline_models.mechanism: Self-magnification makes submissive service feel too weighty; refusal of voluntary lowering is reversed into compelled inward movement and public abjection.

activation_trace.role: Claimed greatness supplies the upward posture that resists service.
Felt heaviness explains why accepting worship is treated as an unbearable burden.
Obedient, lowered service supplies the posture being refused.
A leveled, made-traversable way makes worship a path one consents to tread.
Crossing into an interior supplies the compulsory spatial consequence.
Abjection and coerced yielding complete the inversion of self-elevation.

changed_reading.before: Proud non-worshippers receive an unrelated punishment.
changed_reading.after: The punishment is a precise agency reversal: chosen elevation away from service becomes forced entry in a lowered state.

baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship combines repair and gradual nurture, so answering can mean cultivating a caller or request toward completion rather than delivering an isolated object instantly.

activation_trace.role: Repair and stagewise completion make response an act of formation.
The packet's split mapping contributes nourishment and growth as a secondary lordly image.
The returning answer remains the anchor while its mode becomes developmental.

changed_reading.before: The Lord answers by immediately handing over what was requested.
changed_reading.after: The Lord may answer by repairing, feeding, and completing the caller through a process.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier ربنا petition asks for promised entry into a sheltered garden; the focus gives arrogant refusal its opposite entry into Hell, making response and judgment two spatial outcomes of relation to the Lord.

activation_trace.role: Direct address anchors both the focus command and the earlier petition.
The promised return is given a possible spatial outcome by the context.
Repeated lord-address establishes the extended petition as the focus command enacted.
Requested admission supplies a positive counterpart to the focus's threatened admission.
The sheltered garden specifies the requested interior.
A hope-opening promise links the requested entrance to committed divine speech.

structural_cues: 40:7-9 is an extended ربنا petition, and 40:8 uses وأدخلهم before 40:60 uses سيدخلون.
The positive entrance preserves family relations, while the focus's negative entrance ends in abjection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two Lord-addressed entrance constructions and an explicit promise; I infer a deliberate positive-negative spatial pairing, though the answer in 40:60 can still take non-spatial forms.

changed_reading.before: The answer is unspecified, while Hell-entry is only a later threat.
changed_reading.after: The surah frames calling and refusal through paired admissions: petition can open a sheltered interior, while pride culminates in forced entry into its opposite.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah stages rival invitations toward rescue and fire, then repeats calling with purified obedience; ادعوني therefore functions as exclusive alignment in a contested field, not merely request-making.

activation_trace.role: Claim and affiliation allow calling to identify whose authority the caller owns.
Obedient service makes affiliation behavioral rather than merely vocal.
Reciprocal invitations expose calling as directional social recruitment.
Release from danger supplies the destination of the faithful invitation.
Shared authority supplies the rival relational structure.
The repeated imperative confirms direct calling as the required turn.
Exclusive separation from partnership constrains the call's allegiance.
Obedience and yielding turn invocation into a lived relation.

structural_cues: 40:41-43 repeatedly contrasts دعوتكم and تدعونني with destinations of rescue and fire.
40:14 and 40:65 repeat call plus إخلاص الدين; 40:66 joins worship, rival calling, and submission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed invitations and repeated exclusive-obedience grammar; I infer that prayer marks allegiance, while the live alternative is that these passages only regulate the object of ordinary petition.

changed_reading.before: ادعوني is a content-neutral technique for asking.
changed_reading.after: ادعوني asks the addressee to choose and enact an exclusive direction of belonging amid competing calls.

context_deltas.mechanism: The believing speaker seeks refuge, returns his affair to God, and is then protected; the sequence enacts response as assumption of a delegated burden and concrete warding of harm.

activation_trace.role: Directed address anchors refuge and delegation as forms of calling.
Return of answer is concretized by the later protective outcome.
Taking refuge supplies an early practical form of appeal.
Returning one's affair to another supplies transfer of reliance.
Active warding of injury supplies the observable answer.

structural_cues: 40:44 ends with entrusting the affair to God; 40:45 immediately begins with God's protection.
40:27 had already rendered the speaker's Godward turn as refuge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delegation followed immediately by protection; I infer a response arrow between them, though protection could alternatively answer the speaker's whole faithful stance rather than the single act of delegation.

changed_reading.before: Answer means a verbal reply or delivery of a requested object.
changed_reading.after: Answer can be God taking charge of what was entrusted and converting appeal into protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those already in the fire ask custodians to call 'your Lord' for one day's relief; the reply points back to refused messengers and names their prayer lost, while late faith later brings no benefit.

activation_trace.role: The direct first-person imperative establishes the access against which later mediation is read.
Committed return is qualified by the contrasting failed call.
A request that someone else call supplies mediated, delayed address.
The phrase 'your Lord' exposes relational distance from the direct 'your Lord said' of the focus.
Lightening a burden specifies the minimal late request.
Repeated prayer is explicitly shown continuing without reaching its aim.
Departure from a directed aim characterizes the failed prayer.
Absence of benefit when faith comes late confirms a temporal limit on reversal.

structural_cues: 40:49 shifts from the focus's ادعوني to ادعوا ربكم and asks only for one day.
40:50 answers with the history of messengers; 40:84-85 shows recognition after seeing punishment arriving too late.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct versus mediated address, prior refusal, and late non-benefit; I infer that the promise is relational and timely rather than mechanical, while disbelief, mediation, and lateness remain competing explanations for failure.

changed_reading.before: I will answer you is an unrestricted formula detachable from worship and time.
changed_reading.after: The direct present invitation can be forfeited into a distant, delegated, late call that no longer reaches its purpose.

context_deltas.mechanism: The one called is repeatedly the hearing, seeing judge who decides in truth, while rival objects of calling decide nothing; response is attentive adjudication, not automatic compliance with the caller's preferred outcome.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign lordship supplies authority over the answer's form.
Return of answer remains certain while context specifies its judging agent.
Calling rival objects establishes the contrast in responsive capacity.
Decisive judgment distinguishes God's action from the rivals' inability.
Correspondence with reality constrains the divine decision.
Auditory reception guarantees that the call is apprehended.
Seeing supplies awareness of the caller and circumstances beyond spoken content.
The repeated hearing attribute immediately before the focus primes the answer promise.
The paired seeing attribute completes the immediate attentional frame.

structural_cues: 40:20 joins calling, judging, truth, hearing, and seeing in one contrast.
40:56 closes with السميع البصير only a few lines before ادعوني أستجب لكم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hearing, sight, and truth-governed judgment around acts of calling; I infer that answer is adjudicated care rather than compliance, though hearing and sight could merely assure awareness without specifying answer criteria.

changed_reading.before: Answer means granting the caller's stated preference.
changed_reading.after: Answer means the sovereign has fully received and judged the call in truth, so its faithful form need not duplicate the request.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated pride is located in heart and chest, stamped shut, and described as a magnitude its bearers will never reach; refusal to call is therefore an inward project of impossible enlargement that disables receptive relation.

activation_trace.role: Self-exalting greatness anchors the refusal.
Receptive obedience supplies the posture blocked by self-enlargement.
Repeated magnitude and arrogance connect disputed speech to the closed interior.
A stamped closure supplies the mechanism that prevents reception.
The heart locates the closure within the agent rather than only in public behavior.
The chest as the source from which acts proceed makes pride causally productive.
Magnification held inward supplies the concealed aspiration.
Failure to reach an intended limit exposes the project as impossible.

structural_cues: 40:35 links arrogant disputation, stamping, and the heart.
40:56 places كبر in breasts, denies its attainment, and immediately prescribes refuge before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inner pride, sealing, and failed attainment; I infer a blocked call-answer receptivity, while the alternative is a narrower account of argumentative arrogance without a prayer mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Arrogance is an overt refusal to perform worship.
changed_reading.after: Arrogance is a sealed inner effort to become too large to receive, making non-calling a failure of relational permeability.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, made conditions for rest, stable habitation, provision, staged gestation, arrival at successive limits, and performative divine speech expand lordly answer into an already operating ecology of formation.

activation_trace.role: Nurturing completion anchors the environmental and developmental reading.
The split growth branch sharpens stagewise formation while remaining secondary.
The answer anchor receives multiple created modes and time scales.
Deliberate making supplies built conditions rather than a merely verbal reply.
Restful familiarity specifies one beneficent affordance.
Gift and beneficence identify the made order as care.
Stability supplies a habitable ground for response.
Allocated giving supplies material answer.
A pregnancy that takes hold contributes hidden developmental continuity.
Successive arrivals at limits make maturation a timed process.
Divine utterance that immediately effects being backs the focus promise with performative power.

structural_cues: 40:61 follows the focus immediately and repeats لكم while listing night, rest, sight, and فضل.
40:62 and 40:64 repeat ربكم; 40:67 supplies life stages; 40:68 closes the unit with يقول له كن فيكون.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies crafted affordances, staged life, and effective speech; I infer these as modes of lordly answer, though they can alternatively function as general grounds for gratitude rather than responses to individual calls.

changed_reading.before: Response is a discrete event beginning only after a person asks.
changed_reading.after: Response can be the Lord's ongoing provisioned world, gradual formation, and effective decree within which a call is carried to completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning away from signs is materialized as loss of bodily direction: necks are collared, linked, and dragged until the arrogant cross doors into a fixed abode. The focus's entry and abjection are the endpoint of a transport sequence.

activation_trace.role: A voluntarily traversable service-way supplies the refused mode of movement.
Interior crossing anchors the transport's endpoint.
Coerced lowliness names the final loss of self-direction.
Being turned from a face or direction begins the reversal of agency.
A restraining collar transfers control to an external force.
Connected links make the compelled movement continuous.
Dragging and extension supply the force that replaces voluntary approach.
The explicit entry command realizes the focus's future verb.
A defined portal turns generic entry into routed admission.
Enduring persistence prevents the compelled placement from quickly dissolving.
Settled residence converts transport into habitation.
The repeated arrogant class identifies the transported people with the focus clause.

structural_cues: 40:69 asks how disputants are turned; 40:71-72 supplies collars, chains, dragging, and fire.
40:76 repeats both entering and arrogance, then adds doors, permanence, and settled abode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered movement from turning to restraint, dragging, portal, and residence; I infer a reversal of voluntary agency, though the sequence can also be read simply as cumulative punishment imagery.

changed_reading.before: They will enter Hell is a bare destination statement.
changed_reading.after: Entry is the terminal phase of forced transport: self-directed turning away becomes bodily redirection, dragged passage, and permanent placement.

context_deltas.mechanism: A need located in the chest is brought to a goal through God-given conveyance; calling externalizes that inner need, and response can be the carrying path by which it reaches its terminus.

activation_trace.role: Vocal address moves an inward need into directed relation.
Traversal across distance contributes a transport image to response.
Actual answer keeps the transport image anchored to أستجب.
Arrival at a goal supplies the successful endpoint.
Pressing need supplies what seeks movement.
The action-generating interior locates the need before it is carried outward.
A vessel moving through water supplies one God-given route.
Bearing a visible load supplies the enabling force.

structural_cues: 40:79-80 repeats لكم and says that an inner need is reached while people are carried on animals and ships.
The focus's لكم after أستجب is thus echoed by a later benefit-and-conveyance sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inner need, reaching, vessels, and carrying; I map that sequence onto call and response as transport, while the live alternative is that it concerns ordinary travel benefits with no prayer-specific arrow.

changed_reading.before: A request is answered only when the desired object appears.
changed_reading.after: An answer may be the provided carrier, route, and gradual conveyance by which a need from the chest reaches its goal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Patience accompanies the true promise, the messenger may or may not witness what is promised, signs arrive only by permission, and recognition after punishment is non-beneficial; answer is assured but not caller-scheduled.

activation_trace.role: Committed return is the promise whose timing is being qualified.
Holding oneself against panic supplies the posture required before fulfillment.
Promise opens hope before its object is visible.
A promise indexed to time or place explains why fulfillment need not be immediate.
Ultimate return extends the answer horizon beyond what the messenger witnesses.
Authorization reserves control of signs and their timing to God.
Failed benefit marks a point after which the human response is too late.
A recurrent governing way makes the timing pattern stable rather than arbitrary.

structural_cues: 40:55 places patience and the true promise immediately before the focus unit.
40:77 permits fulfillment either within or beyond the messenger's sight; 40:78 and 40:85 constrain sign and late response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies promise, patience, non-witness, permission, and late non-benefit; I infer sovereign timing for response, though the permission and lateness passages may apply specifically to signs and judgment rather than every petition.

changed_reading.before: I will answer you implies an answer on the caller's timetable.
changed_reading.after: The promise is firm while its manifestation remains under divine timing, possibly beyond present sight, and the caller's own answer can arrive too late.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant د ع ع split mapping for focus د ع و; it remains anchored to ادعوني and gains contextual force from literal dragging and entry, but downstream prose should call it an exploratory lexical shadow, never translate ادعوني as 'push.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet's secondary mapped target for د ع و in ادعوني, read against سيدخلون داخرين.

activation_trace.role: The split target contributes violent propulsion as a shadow behind the voluntary verbal turn.
Dragging materializes the involuntary motion suggested only remotely by the split branch.
Compelled crossing supplies the destination of that motion.
Humiliated yielding contains the image within the focus's explicit consequence.

changed_reading.before: The invitation to call and the punishment clause have unrelated motion profiles.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, refusal of a voluntary vocal inclination is shadowed by its inverse: externally imposed propulsion into abjection.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's ج ب ي split target under focus ج و ب; it remains anchored to أستجب and is sharpened by the earlier family-inclusive garden petition, but it should be rendered as a secondary resonance of gathering or bringing near, not as the lexical translation of أستجب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split inventory beneath ج و ب in أستجب.

activation_trace.role: Collection and acquisition contribute an answer that gathers rather than merely replies.
Selection and nearness contribute relational admission.
Requested admission supplies the action by which gathering becomes spatial.
The sheltered garden supplies the collective destination.

changed_reading.before: Answer returns information or grants an item to an isolated caller.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, answer gathers and brings the caller near, potentially admitting the caller together with righteous relations.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the hidden-defect branch of the same د خ ل root that explicitly means entering in the focus; it remains anchored through the chest, sealed-heart, and repeated entry sequence, but downstream prose should present an inside-out spatial analogy rather than claim that the verb itself means inner corruption here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سيدخلون read with the focus inventory's inward-defect branch and the pride clause.

activation_trace.role: A concealed inner flaw supplies the internal state that can later be spatialized.
Sealing fixes the defect within the person.
The heart locates the sealed condition internally.
The chest as source of acts connects inner condition to outward trajectory.
Internal magnification identifies the concealed defect as pride.
Literal entrance converts the inner-state analogy into an outer enclosure.

changed_reading.before: Hell is only an external destination imposed after inward pride.
changed_reading.after: The context supports an inside-out reversal in which a sealed inner corruption becomes the exterior habitation the person enters.

strongest_changes: The answer promise became a direct relational circuit whose enacted forms include protection, adjudication, provision, and developmental completion.
The threat became an agency-reversal sequence: voluntary service is refused, then direction, movement, entry, and residence are externally imposed.
Repeated rival calls and failed late prayer made invocation an exclusive, timely allegiance rather than a detachable request technique.
The later image of an inner need carried to its goal opened a transport model for how response may work.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly enacted the focus vocabulary: ربنا petitions seek entry, delegation is followed by protection, pride is sealed inside the chest, created affordances follow the promise, and turning away develops into chains, dragging, doors, and fixed abode. Split mappings then preserved contained echoes of pushing, opening, traversal, and gathering.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether opening, gathering, and forced-push resonances are productive split-root activations or only form-distant packet echoes.
Whether the failed prayer in 40:49-50 is controlled chiefly by disbelief, relational distance, lateness, or their combination.
Whether created affordances and staged growth are answers to calls specifically or broader lordly beneficence that only analogically models answer.
